items.statement: Explain the observed benzylic C–Cl connectivity through a computed local regioselectivity account.
items.expected: A physically justified local model connects actual atom-resolved calculations to preferential chlorine placement at the benzylic allene terminus while phenylsulfonyl is on the central carbon. The source-supported account uses lower C1 than C3 capture precursors within both stereochemical families and local steric/coordination differences. It must explain the connectivity and preference, not just repeat the observed product or list structures. Thermodynamic evidence uses matched molecular inventories, charge/spin, solvent and free-energy reference at 313.15 K or demonstrated transfer to it. In AR, an established alternative local mechanism may pass without constructing the four author minima. In PR, assess the disclosed baseline and any documented substitution. A stronger kinetic claim requires its own appropriate evidence. For PR, report the three requested reconstructed source-column relative solution Gibbs energies with their electronic and thermal components, including both C3 values relative to C1 syn,syn. Preserve the unresolved printed G273.15 temperature and distinguish reconstruction from 313.15 K reaction inference. These numerical results substantiate the explanation without source-target or tolerance gates. AR has no required author-four-minimum inventory.

items.statement: Explain the observed Z alkene geometry through a computed local stereochemical account.
items.expected: Connect genuine calculated relative stability and chemically mapped substituent arrangement to the observed Z product. The source-supported account has lower C1 syn,syn than syn,anti, with structural differences compatible with greater crowding/distortion in syn,anti; distinguish n-propyl and ester-carbonyl atoms consistently. Explain how precursor geometry gives the product configuration using actual chemical priorities or equivalent unambiguous mapping. An angle or the source 2.3 kcal/mol difference alone is not an isolated strain energy. Use reaction-condition evidence or supported transfer to 313.15 K. Equivalent demonstrated physical explanations pass, with no mandatory author-intermediate sequence in AR. In PR assess the disclosed source geometry rationale; panel-local C4 labels are not invariant chemical roles. For PR, the requested C1 syn,anti minus syn,syn source-column Gibbs result remains evidence for this structural explanation. Preserve its declared reconstruction assumptions rather than matching the printed 2.292292 kcal/mol; the two C3 source-column values are required evidence for the regioselectivity comparison.

items.statement: Determine what the computed local evidence and supplied controls establish about selectivity under the reaction conditions.
items.expected: Derive the explanatory scope of the computed local model from the observables it actually establishes and the supplied controls. For the reference evidence, finite intermediate free energies and mapped outlet geometry establish a conditional thermodynamic/structural rationale, while radical trapping, catalyst omission and quenching support participation without uniquely selecting the local C–Cl transfer route. Show why those data do not determine competing activation barriers, an exact Z/E ratio or a unique active Cu coordination/spin state. Temperature/model transfer must be assessed from actual calculations; a missing calculation or a generic list of cautions does not establish this conclusion. A quantitatively stronger, properly supported bounded conclusion is acceptable. PR must distinguish source-column reconstruction, unresolved source temperature and reaction-condition inference.
